# 💳 Sheet to Report (gws CLI)

💳 Requires a paid Google Workspace account for the gws CLI — no free tier. Curated by Skill Harbor — a step-by-step recipe that reads a Sheet range, creates a Google Doc, writes a formatted report into it (`gws docs +write` with headings and summaries), and shares it with stakeholders. Distinct from the sibling recipe compare-sheet-tabs: that one diffs two tabs; this one turns Sheet data into a shareable report document. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: the recipe assumes the gws-sheets, gws-docs and gws-drive utility skills are loaded and the gws binary is installed and authenticated; the report's narrative is written by the agent — the recipe provides the mechanics, not the analysis. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
